mechanism.claim: Several robust-scale BTC jumps arriving within short completed intervals are an aftershock cascade rather than one isolated discontinuity. When the cascade's signed jump mass is nonzero during elevated realized variation, follow its net direction for eight hours at a fresh upper-tail excitation onset.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the sum of completed jump returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVBJR acts on one five-minute return relative to strictly-prior bipower variation and fades it. Absolute-return clustering uses lag-one correlation across every return magnitude. Cojump candidates compare assets. HVSJAC defines multiple within-block jumps from one median absolute-return scale, measures only inter-jump gap concentration, and takes direction only from their signed mass; it uses no prior event set, control, volume, flow, funding, OI, premium, cross-asset input, or fitted outcome.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed eight-hour BTC variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent and short-gap jump excitation its upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily multi-jump aftershock onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact unique coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_aggregation: 96 exact epoch-aligned groups of five rows; OHLC first/max/min/last
features.returns: 95 close-to-close natural-log returns from the 96 five-minute closes
features.inter_jump_gaps: integer differences between consecutive jump indices
features.aftershock_excitation: fraction of inter-jump gaps<=3 five-minute bars, finite in [0,1]
features.excitation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.signed_jump_mass: sum of returns classified as jumps, finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared 95 returns), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid predecessor cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after the full path completes
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no aggregation, robust scale, jump multiple, minimum count, gap, excitation, history, rank, onset, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
